properties.project_name: Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons (interim, west)
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's real-site pass: real, community-surveyed OpenStreetMap boundary (way 446183018), the same pattern already used for Pier 70's Crane Cove Park (data/manual/pier70_crane_cove_park.geojson) -- not a hand trace or plan-diagram estimate. MEDIUM CONFIDENCE -- real, community-surveyed OSM polygon for the current interim installation (Parklab Gardens; the wider parcel also hosts Spark Social SF, Stagecoach Greens mini golf, Urban Sprouts community garden and an SFF soccer field per SF Rec & Park's own Future Parks Project page). Marked 'existing' rather than 'complete' because this is explicitly an interim use, not the plan's final build-out: OCII's Mission Bay Future Parks Project will redesign parcels P12/P13/P15 into a permanent, unified extension of the Commons (planning 2024-25, design mid-2026, construction targeted late 2028, public opening targeted early 2030). This feature traces only the Parklab Gardens sub-area, the most clearly-bounded of several interim uses on the same parcels -- a second pass could digitize the soccer-field/Stagecoach Greens portions separately. SOURCES ADDED 2026-09-23: the owner asked whether the P12/P13/P15 sources included SF Rec & Park's own community-workshop decks -- they didn't yet. Found and verified all three (each fetched directly, not just linked): Community Meeting #1 (Jun 2, 2024), #2 (Oct 29, 2024) and #3 (Apr 29, 2025, 83 pages) -- #3 has individually labeled concept-plan pages for P12, P13 and P15 (soccer pitches and outdoor fitness on P12; food trucks, outdoor dining and a pavilion on P15, matching Spark Social SF's current use of that parcel) plus an alternative option for P12. These are design-workshop concepts, not an adopted final plan -- the design team was only selected via an Aug 2025 OCII/MBDG RFQ, after Workshop 3. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: corrections to the description above. (1) The sentence 'This feature traces only the Parklab Gardens sub-area' is wrong: the mapped polygon is OSM way 446183018 (leisure=park, name 'Parklab', about 14,665 sq m, roughly 420 m long), the whole Parklab park strip, which fully contains the Parklab Gardens way (437595662) and the Spark Social SF way (437591532). (2) P15's food-truck/outdoor-dining/pavilion concept does not match Spark Social SF's use: OCII's Nov 14, 2024 CAC update puts Spark Social SF on P13 and Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens on P15. (3) 'The design team was only selected via an Aug 2025 OCII/MBDG RFQ' overstates it: SF Rec & Park's Future Parks page says an RFQ was released in early August 2025 and a design team 'should be selected by mid-October'; it does not report that a selection happened. (4) digitized_from now states the OSM tag as leisure=park (was leisure=garden). (5) The planning schedule is now stated as SF Rec & Park's page gives it (planning 2024-2025, design mid-2026); the Workshop 3 deck p.15 shows construction 'mid-2027 thru 2028'.
properties.accuracy_caveat: MEDIUM CONFIDENCE -- real, community-surveyed OSM polygon for the current interim installation (Parklab Gardens; the wider parcel also hosts Spark Social SF, Stagecoach Greens mini golf, Urban Sprouts community garden and an SFF soccer field per SF Rec & Park's own Future Parks Project page). Marked 'existing' rather than 'complete' because this is explicitly an interim use, not the plan's final build-out: OCII's Mission Bay Future Parks Project will redesign parcels P12/P13/P15 into a permanent, unified extension of the Commons (planning 2024-25, design mid-2026, construction targeted late 2028, public opening targeted early 2030). This feature traces OSM way 446183018 (leisure=park, name 'Parklab', about 14,665 sq m and roughly 420 m long), the whole Parklab park strip: it fully contains the separately mapped Parklab Gardens way (437595662, about 2,212 sq m) and the Spark Social SF way (437591532, about 1,519 sq m), so it is not only the Parklab Gardens sub-area.
properties.p_number: Likely corresponds to P12 (SFF Soccer + Fitness Court), P13 (Community Garden & SPARK Social SF) and/or P15 (Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens) within OCII's 'Mission Bay Commons (P11, P12, P13, P15, P16, P17)' assemblage, since those three are the still-interim installations (P11/P16/P17 are the already-completed park build-outs, tracked separately as 'Mission Bay Commons' above). properties.notes: Interim open-space use on the future P12/P13/P15 parcels; will be rebuilt as part of the Mission Bay Future Parks Project. SF Rec & Park's project page gives planning 2024-2025, design mid-2026, construction beginning late 2028 and public opening early 2030; its Workshop 3 deck (p.15) shows construction 'mid-2027 thru 2028', so the schedules differ.
